name: Sensible Stock
author: Richard27

sections.description:
Many WooCommerce store owners still make purchasing decisions based on guesswork.

This often leads to:

  • Stock shortages and missed sales
  • Excess inventory sitting on the shelf
  • Cash tied up in slow-moving products
  • Time-consuming manual calculations

Sensible Stock helps you make better purchasing decisions using your own sales data.

The plugin analyses sales history, current stock levels, supplier settings, lead times and minimum order quantities to generate practical reorder advice directly inside WooCommerce.

What Sensible Stock helps you do

  • Know what to order
  • Know when to order
  • Know how much to order
  • Reduce stock shortages
  • Reduce overstock
  • Improve cash flow
  • Save time on inventory planning

Key Features

  • Purchase Advice Dashboard
  • Supplier Management
  • Product Minimum Quantities
  • Lead Time Management
  • Incoming Goods Workflow
  • HPOS Compatibility
  • WooCommerce Integration

Sensible Stock works entirely inside WordPress and WooCommerce, without requiring an external inventory management system.

Perfect For

  • Retail stores
  • Webshops
  • Specialty stores
  • Multi-supplier businesses
  • WooCommerce merchants looking for smarter inventory planning

More information:
https://sensiblestock.com

External Services

Sensible Stock includes the Freemius SDK for optional account connection, software updates, support and usage analytics.

The plugin remains usable without connecting to Freemius. Data is only shared with Freemius after the site administrator explicitly opts in through the Freemius consent screen.

Freemius service terms:
https://freemius.com/terms/

Freemius privacy policy:
https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sensible-stock directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Open Sensible Stock in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure suppliers, lead times and minimum quantities.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Sensible Stock is built for WooCommerce stores.

Does this plugin support HPOS?

Yes. Sensible Stock is designed to work with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Is a Freemius account required?

No. The included plugin functionality remains usable without connecting a Freemius account. Freemius is used for optional opt-in account features, support, updates and usage analytics.

Does inventory data leave my website?

Core inventory and order calculations are processed inside your WordPress installation. Freemius only receives data after the site administrator explicitly opts in through the Freemius consent screen.

  • Improved inventory dashboard workflow.
  • Improved HPOS order data handling.
